title: Commercial Interior
tagline: Spaces that work as hard as the business inside them.
summary: Design and delivery of offices, showrooms, clinics and corporate floors — planned around headcount, workflow and brand.
intro: A commercial interior has to carry a business day after day: acoustics that let people concentrate, circulation that does not bottleneck at the printer, meeting rooms that actually get used, and a reception that says the right thing in the first eight seconds.
We start from your headcount plan and workflow rather than from a mood board. Layout comes first, then services, then the layer of material and light that makes the place feel like yours.
deliverables: Test-fit and space plan with headcount validation
Reflected ceiling, power and data layouts
Acoustic zoning and meeting-room specification
Material palette, joinery drawings and finishes schedule
Photoreal 3D views of every key space
Line-item BOQ with a fixed-price proposal

faq.q: Can you work around a live office?
faq.a: Yes. We phase the work floor by floor, run noisy trades outside business hours, and maintain temporary partitions and dust screens so your team keeps working.

faq.q: Do you handle MEP and approvals?
faq.a: We coordinate MEP design, fire and building-management approvals as part of a turnkey scope. Where a landlord insists on their own contractor, we produce drawings they can build from.

title: Residential Interior
tagline: Homes designed around the way your family actually lives.
summary: Full-home and single-room residential design — layouts, joinery, lighting, materials and styling, delivered to a fixed price.
intro: Most homes are not short of furniture — they are short of decisions. Where the coats go, how the kitchen handles a Friday dinner, whether the bedroom can be dark at 6am in June.
We work through those decisions with you room by room, then draw everything so the result matches the picture you approved.
deliverables: Room-by-room layout and furniture plan
Bespoke wardrobe, kitchen and TV-unit joinery drawings
Lighting plan with scene setting and dimming
Material, fabric and colour schedule
3D visuals of principal rooms
Itemised quotation and delivery programme

faq.q: Can we keep some existing furniture?
faq.a: Always. We plan around the pieces you love and tell you honestly which ones will not survive the new layout.

faq.q: Do you do single rooms?
faq.a: Yes — kitchens, wardrobes and primary bedrooms are our most common single-room commissions.

title: Office & Corporate
tagline: Workplace that reflects how your company actually operates.
summary: Corporate workplace strategy, design and build — boardrooms, focus rooms, cafés and reception floors.
intro: A head office is a communication device. The boardroom sets the tone for a client, the café floor sets the tone for the team, and the reception sets it for everybody else.
We design all three registers together so the building reads as one company rather than four different fit-outs.
deliverables: Workplace strategy and adjacency study
Boardroom, exec-suite and reception design
Acoustic and AV integration specification
Branded environmental graphics
Furniture specification and procurement
Phased construction programme

faq.q: Do you procure loose furniture?
faq.a: Yes. We specify, tender, inspect at the factory and install — task chairs, soft seating, tables and storage.

faq.q: Can you match a global brand standard?
faq.a: We work from brand manuals regularly and produce a local adaptation drawing set for your regional approval.

title: Retail & Shop
tagline: Interiors that turn footfall into dwell time.
summary: Shop, boutique and showroom interiors with fixture design, lighting for merchandise and a rollout-ready detail pack.
intro: Retail is a numbers game with a theatre budget. Sightlines decide what gets seen, lighting decides what looks worth buying, and the till queue decides how the visit ends.
We design the customer journey first, then build the fixtures that support it — and document everything so store two is cheaper than store one.
deliverables: Customer journey and zoning plan
Bespoke fixture and gondola design
Merchandise lighting layout with lux targets
Counter, trial and stockroom design
Signage and graphic integration
Rollout detail pack for multi-store programs

faq.q: Can you build while the shop trades?
faq.a: Yes — night shifts, hoarding and phased fixture swaps. We have delivered several stores without a single lost trading day.

faq.q: Do you provide a fixture-only package?
faq.a: We do. Send drawings and we will manufacture, finish and install the joinery and metalwork.

title: Brand Shop & Outlet
tagline: Flagship stores and franchise rollouts built to a manual.
summary: Brand-standard outlet design, franchise manuals, prototyping and multi-city rollout delivery.
intro: A franchise only works if outlet forty looks like outlet one. That means a manual that a local contractor can actually follow, tolerances that survive a real site, and a prototype store that proves the details before you commit.
We build the prototype, write the manual, then supervise the rollout.
deliverables: Brand-standard design language and prototype store
Franchise fit-out manual with drawings and schedules
Approved supplier and material substitutions list
Site survey template and landlord condition report
Rollout programme and cost model per store type
QA checklist and snag-handover protocol

faq.q: Do you work with our existing brand agency?
faq.a: Regularly. We take the brand book and turn it into buildable detail — usually finding three or four things that will not work on site and proposing alternatives.

faq.q: Can you train our local contractors?
faq.a: Yes. We run a one-day installation workshop at the prototype store for each new city.

title: Office Fit-Out
tagline: From bare shell to occupied floor, on one contract.
summary: Turnkey office fit-out: partitions, ceilings, MEP, flooring, joinery, furniture, IT and handover.
intro: Fit-out is where most projects lose money — through unclear scope boundaries, landlord conditions nobody read, and services that clash with the ceiling design.
We take a single contract for the whole floor, coordinate the landlord's base build, and publish a weekly programme everyone can hold us to.
deliverables: Shell-and-core condition survey and landlord liaison
MEP design and coordination (HVAC, power, data, fire)
Partitions, ceilings, flooring and finishes
Joinery manufacture and installation
Furniture supply, IT and access-control coordination
Testing, commissioning, snag list and handover pack

faq.q: Who deals with building management?
faq.a: We do — permits, work hours, hoarding, insurance, lift bookings and the reinstatement list at the end of your lease.

faq.q: Is furniture included?
faq.a: Optional. Many clients take our specification and buy direct; we will still deliver, install and warrant the fixed elements.

title: Commercial Fit-Out
tagline: Retail, clinic and hospitality fit-out delivered to a trading date.
summary: Design-and-build fit-out for commercial units where the opening date is not negotiable.
intro: Commercial units come with a rent clock. Every week of programme is money, so we plan the critical path backwards from your trading date and protect it.
Long-lead items are ordered in week one, services are coordinated before the ceiling closes, and finishes are installed in a sequence that does not need re-work.
deliverables: Programme built backwards from the trading date
Landlord and authority approvals support
MEP, services and kitchen/extraction coordination
Joinery, metalwork and countertop manufacture
Finishes, flooring and decorative lighting
Commissioning, staff familiarisation and handover

faq.q: What if the landlord delays the shell?
faq.a: We track float in the programme weekly and re-sequence trades. You get a written note the day a delay becomes real, not at handover.

faq.q: Do you handle kitchen extraction and gas?
faq.a: Yes, including canopies, ducting routes, make-up air and the approvals that go with them.

title: Residential Fit-Out
tagline: Whole-home execution with one team on site from demolition to styling.
summary: Turnkey home fit-out: civil work, services, joinery, finishes, furnishing and final styling.
intro: Living through a renovation is the hard part, not the design. Our job is to keep dust, noise and decisions off your plate.
One site supervisor, one WhatsApp thread, one weekly report with photos — and a snag list we close before we ask for the final payment.
deliverables: Demolition, civil and waterproofing works
Electrical, plumbing and HVAC re-routing
False ceiling, flooring and wall finishes
Bespoke joinery: kitchens, wardrobes, vanities
Loose furniture, curtains, rugs and lighting supply
Deep clean, styling and handover walkthrough

faq.q: Can we live in the house during work?
faq.a: Often yes, if we can zone the house and keep one bathroom and the kitchen live. We will tell you honestly when it is better to move out for six weeks.

faq.q: How do you handle changes?
faq.a: Every variation is priced and signed before it is built. No surprise invoices at handover.

title: Turnkey Interiors
tagline: One contract, one accountability, one handover.
summary: Complete design-and-build packages: survey, design, approvals, manufacture, site, furniture and warranty.
intro: Turnkey means you stop managing four vendors who each blame the other. We survey, design, get approvals, manufacture in our own workshop, run the site, install furniture and hand over with a warranty.
It is the most common way our commercial clients buy, and the reason our budget variance stays under three percent.
deliverables: Measured survey and existing-conditions report
Concept, design development and construction drawings
Authority, landlord and society approvals
In-house joinery and metalwork manufacture
Full site execution with a dedicated supervisor
Furniture, styling, testing and a 10-year warranty

faq.q: What is your payment structure?
faq.a: Typically 25% mobilisation, monthly progress payments against a measured programme, and 5% retention released after the defect-liability period.

faq.q: Can we bring our own architect?
faq.a: Absolutely. We will build to their drawings and take responsibility for the execution and coordination.

title: Interior Renovation
tagline: Bring an older space back — without rebuilding what still works.
summary: Selective renovation: re-planning, re-servicing and re-finishing existing interiors, room by room.
intro: Renovation is an exercise in judgement: what is structurally fine, what is merely tired, and what is actively working against you.
We survey honestly, tell you where the money should not go, and then re-plan the parts that change how the space feels.
deliverables: Condition survey with a keep / repair / replace schedule
Re-planning of layout, storage and circulation
Service upgrades: wiring, plumbing, lighting circuits
Surface renewal: flooring, paint, wall panelling
Joinery replacement or re-facing
Phased programme to minimise disruption

faq.q: Do you keep original features?
faq.a: Where they are sound, yes — terrazzo, timber doors and mouldings are usually worth restoring rather than replacing.

faq.q: Can renovation be done room by room?
faq.a: That is how most of our residential renovations run. We sequence so you always have a working kitchen and bathroom.

title: Restaurant Interior
tagline: Atmosphere, flow and a reason to come back.
summary: Full-service restaurant design: front of house, bar, kitchen coordination, acoustics and lighting.
intro: A restaurant lives or dies on the back-of-house line and the light on the table. Get the pass, the dishwasher run and the extraction right and the service feels effortless; get the lighting right and the food photographs itself.
We design front and back together, with your chef and your operations lead in the room from week one.
deliverables: Cover plan, table mix and covers-per-hour modelling
Kitchen workflow review and BOH coordination
Bar, host stand and service-station design
Acoustic treatment for a full room
Layered lighting design with scene control
FF&E specification, procurement and installation

faq.q: Do you design commercial kitchens?
faq.a: We coordinate the kitchen layout and services with your kitchen consultant and equipment supplier, and take responsibility for the interfaces.

faq.q: How do you handle noise?
faq.a: Measured targets — usually 72–78 dB at full covers — achieved with absorbent ceiling rafts, upholstered banquettes and textured wall panels rather than visible acoustic foam.

title: Cafe Interior
tagline: Small footprint, strong identity, fast build.
summary: Café and coffee-house interiors designed for throughput, dwell time and a photogenic counter.
intro: A café has maybe forty square feet to make its argument: the counter, the espresso machine, the pastry case and the light behind them.
We design that moment first, then work out how many people can sit, stand, queue and leave without colliding.
deliverables: Counter and queue-line design
Barista workflow and equipment setting-out
Seating mix for dwell time and turnover
Signage, menu boards and graphic integration
Warm layered lighting for day and evening
Fast-track build programme

faq.q: Can you design for a kiosk?
faq.a: Yes — we have built 210 sq ft kiosks where every millimetre of counter was drawn as a prototype first.

faq.q: Do you supply the equipment?
faq.a: We can procure and install espresso machines, grinders and refrigeration through our supplier network, or set out for equipment you already own.

title: Custom Furniture & Joinery
tagline: Made in our own workshop, to the millimetre.
summary: Bespoke joinery, cabinetry and loose furniture manufactured in-house and installed by our own teams.
intro: Our workshop is the reason our fit-outs look the way they do: 22,000 sq ft of panel processing, veneer pressing, spray finishing and metal fabrication under one roof.
Nothing is subcontracted to a third-party carpenter who has never seen your drawing.
deliverables: Shop drawings for every piece before production
Kitchens, wardrobes, vanities and wall panelling
Loose furniture: tables, beds, consoles, shelving
Veneer, laminate, lacquer and solid-timber finishes
Metalwork: frames, screens, handrails, fixtures
Site installation, adjustment and a 10-year warranty

faq.q: Can you build from someone else's drawings?
faq.a: Yes. Send the drawing set and we will return a shop-drawing pack for your approval before cutting.

faq.q: What finishes can you achieve?
faq.a: PU and acrylic lacquer, natural veneer with book-matching, laminate, Duco, powder-coated metal, solid surface and quartz worktops.

title: Office Furniture
summary: Workplace furniture procurement — task seating, desks, storage, soft seating and acoustic furniture.
intro: Furniture is where budgets quietly leak: three suppliers, four lead times, and a chair that arrives in the wrong fabric the week you move in.
We write one specification, tender it across our supplier panel, inspect at the factory, and install in a single weekend.
deliverables: Furniture schedule with finishes and codes
Ergonomic and task-chair specification
Height-adjustable and bench desk systems
Storage, lockers and acoustic screens
Soft seating, café and breakout furniture
Factory inspection, delivery, install and asset tagging

faq.q: Do you import?
faq.a: We do, for specified ergonomic seating and systems furniture. We handle the freight, duty and lead-time risk inside our quotation.

faq.q: Can you re-use our existing desks?
faq.a: Usually. We survey what you have, tell you what is worth keeping, and design the new plan around it.

title: 3D Studio & Visualisation
tagline: See it, approve it, then we build exactly that.
summary: Photoreal stills, walkthrough animations and VR-ready scenes for design approval and marketing.
intro: A drawing convinces an architect; a render convinces everybody else — the investor, the landlord, the spouse, the board.
Our visualisation team builds from the same model the workshop uses, so the image you approve is the geometry we cut.
deliverables: Massing and white-model study views
Photoreal stills with material and lighting accuracy
Animated walkthroughs up to 90 seconds
VR-ready scenes for headset review
Marketing crops for hoardings and social
Revision rounds included in the fee

faq.q: How many revisions are included?
faq.a: Two full rounds per view, plus unlimited material swaps. Additional rounds are quoted per view.

faq.q: Do you deliver source files?
faq.a: On request, and for clients who sign a full design contract the model forms part of the handover pack.
